plans.idea: Faithful centered poster stack like the original: logo crest at top center, product box large beneath it, the 30% OFF headline block with its copy under the product, and the CTA button centered at the bottom on one shared vertical axis.
Two-column square: product box on the left half, the headline, copy and CTA stacked in a left-aligned column on the right half, with the logo crest anchoring the top-left corner.

Product-led top half with a split bottom band: product box wide across the upper area, then the headline and copy left-aligned in the lower left and the CTA beside them on the right, with the logo crest in the top-left corner.
